title: Two great new repairable gadgets

(If you're new here, welcome, I'm newish here too, and also you can read all the old editions at the Installer homepage.) This week, I've been getting back into the Installer groove, trying out some ergonomic Switch […]
llm_summary: In this edition of “Installer #141,” the author highlights two newly released, repair‑friendly gadgets that stand out for their ergonomic design and modular construction. Both devices are built to be easily opened and serviced, letting users replace parts or upgrade components without needing specialized tools. The piece positions them as top picks for anyone who values longevity and DIY maintenance in their tech gear.
